journey.name: Lift: an easier day
journey.description: After a session that felt very hard, Lift's next session on the program offers an easier day before its first set, and Today says the day is one to take easier and starts it eased. Run on a fresh install with a bell owned.

actions.action: On Train's Strength pillar, tap "Follow a program", find "20 minutes beside BJJ", open it and tap "Follow this program"
Start a free session (not the program's day 1), log a set, tap "Finish", pick "Very hard" under "How was it?" and tap "Done"

Tap the "Today" tab and verify a line ending "strength day" over "The last session felt very hard. Take today a notch easier.", and under the program's day a switch "Easier today", on, over "Presses and squats a bell lighter, swings and snatches shorter", with the button reading "Start day 1, easier"; switch it off and verify the button reads "Start day 1"

On Train's Strength pillar, tap "Start day 1" and verify that a card "Easier today" says "Your last session felt very hard, and it was a day and a half ago at most", "Presses and squats a bell lighter, swings and snatches shorter, rests by the lift" and "Day 2 of this program is the lighter one on the grip", with "Use it"
Tap "Use it" and verify that the card goes and Up next counts 12 sets of the Armor Building Complex, not 15
Finish the session without a "Very hard" and tap "Drop" on "Keep today's changes?"

Clear the app and repeat the first three steps (the switch left on), then tap "Start day 1, easier" on Today instead: verify that Lifting opens with the day already eased ("1 of 12 sets") and no "Easier today" card
